verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows generic mentions of 'AI-powered search and chat' on the developer docs site and a docs-only MCP server (explicitly confirmed to be a documentation server, not a store-operations MCP) — no evidence that store operations (catalog, orders, settings) can be driven by natural-language commands. Missing for 10: any product-level NL command interface, agent/chat control of storefront or admin operations, first-party or third-party demos of NL-driven store management.
